 Genre. S.’s use of ottava rima is continuous with Hymn to Mercury which was completed
the previous month (see headnote to no. 336, Longman iii 508–10)). But Forteguerri’s rela-
tively recent deployment of the form was not his only model. As Rognoni notes, it is found
in Calderón’s dramas, including La cisma de Inglaterra, ottava rima stanzas of which are
transcribed in S.’s letter to Maria Gisborne of 16 November 1819 (L ii 155) (see head-
note to The dewy silence of the breathing night (no. 355, Longman iii 724–5)), Spenser’s
